stories.headline: Google expands Earth AI early access
stories.summary: Google opened early access to new experimental Earth AI capabilities and added $10 million in crisis-resilience and public-health funding.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows Google pushing AI into climate and humanitarian work.

stories.headline: Gemini 4 Argon goes global
stories.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon for developers and enterprises, with access in the Gemini API, app, Search, and Antigravity.
stories.why_it_matters: A fresh flagship model release is likely to shape the competitive AI market.
